QuestInfo.name: Intel from the Knights
QuestInfo.0: Olive's come up with some wild story about a master of disguise, but it sounds a little too convenient. Talk to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart corroborates Olive's story and says his knights and the Explorers must work together against the Black Mage. He writes a letter about the Master of Disguise and gives it to you. \r\nTake it to Athena Pierce.
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart corroborates Olive's story and says his knights and the Explorers must work together against the Black Mage. He writes a letter about the Master of Disguise and gives it to you. \r\nYou deliver it to Athena Pierce.

0.0: Once, not too long ago, a Master of Disguise did in fact infiltrate Ereve. Why do you ask? \r\n#L0##b(You explain the entire situation to Neinheart. He seems trustworthy, right?)#l\n#k
0.1: I see. Then I must tell you, I've seen the Master of Disguise's abilities with my own eyes. His disguises are flawless, in terms of looks. Utterly perfect. If it weren't for a certain knight, I'm not sure what would have become of Ereve. \r\n#L0##bWho saved Ereve?#l\n#k
0.2: It is a lengthy story. I will write a letter to Athena Pierce explaining all that happened. There, I'm done. Take this to Athena Pierce.

yes.0: The Cygnus Knights and Explorers must combine their forces to combat the Black Mage. Come find me when you've made your preparations and are ready to work together.

no.0: You can keep it for yourself if you like. It doesn't matter to me.

1.0: Back from Ereve already, #h0#? \r\n#L0##b(You hand her Neinheart's letter as you explain what happened.)#l\n#k
1.1: A letter from the Cygnus Knights... Interesting.

npc.0: You... do know Athena Pierce, right? Then take the letter to Henesys at once.
